newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market quiet, no trade - private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market quiet, no trade - private.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle trade near midday Friday was inactive following this week's sales that ranged from $102.00 to $104.00 per cwt on a dressed basis, with the bulk trading at $103.00, market sources said.
Cattle owners next week were seen pricing cattle from $104.00 to $105.00, the sources said.

Weekly movement was near 85,000 head, which was below the week's esitmated showlists that ranged as high as 96,000, they said. Next week's showlist was expected from 90,000 to 95,000 head, with a few cattle carried over from this week. Cattle performance on feedlots has been excellent, the sources said.
